page.overview:
What is Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex?

is an entertainment complex owned by Fazbear Entertainment LLC, as well as the primary location of Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach.

The pizzeria's main mascot is Glamrock Freddy from the glamrock band, which also includes Glamrock Chica, Montgomery Gator and Roxanne Wolf. The pizzeria also houses the S.T.A.F.F. Bots and Caution Bots, as well as the Daycare Attendant and DJ Music Man.

The RUIN DLC takes place some time after Security Breach, inside the now abandoned and dilapidated Pizzaplex.
